title: Solvabilizer number of PSL2 for prime powers congruent to one modulo four
statement:
Let $q$ be a prime power satisfying

$$
q\equiv 1 \mod 4.
$$

Set $G=\operatorname{PSL}_{2}(q)$.

**PSL2 congruence conjecture.**

$$
\alpha(G)=q.
$$

This is proposed as a further generalization of the theorem for $\operatorname{PSL}_{2}(2^f)$ and is supported in the paper by the computational table.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.08129

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2024).
source_name: Banafsheh Akbari, Tuval Foguel and Jack Schmidt, “Solvabilizer Numbers of Finite Groups”, arXiv:2403.08129 (2024).
